title: Adversarial suite part 1: generate every cross-tenant case from the schema (report-only, no stack needed)
description:
Outcome: A script reads amplify/data/schema.ts, the function and plugin schema files and the function list and writes the case table (model x operation, each index, each custom query and mutation) plus a Behave feature skeleton with the steps stubbed as pending. CI fails if a model or function has no generated case. No AWS calls in this part. Size: one agent session. Worktree Papyrus-worktrees/ (beside the Papyrus checkout) tenant-isolation-cases, branch feature/<this issue id>-tenant-isolation-cases from origin/develop (spikes: branch spike/<this issue id>-tenant-isolation-cases, sandbox only, no PR needed beyond notes).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): new scripts/generate-tenant-isolation-cases.ts, features_backend/tenant-isolation-adversarial.feature, features_backend/steps/tenant_isolation_steps.py (pending steps).

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-isolation-adversarial.feature):
Scenario: A model without a case fails the build
    Given a model is added to schema.ts
    When the generator check runs in CI
    Then it fails naming the model

Dependencies: blocked by nothing. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: npx tsx scripts/generate-tenant-isolation-cases.ts --check; npm run typecheck; npm run test:bdd:backend (pending steps reported, not failed).
Rollout: Merge to develop by PR when green (not a release; the newsroom automation session owns releases). Record branch, PR and verification on this issue.
Risk and mitigation: Low; scoped to one session.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
